context: Tatsuya's vegetable patch in Iwate, late summer. Hina is visiting on holiday with her family and has come out alone — Tatsuya is showing her how to pick tomatoes.
purpose: tiny instructional warmth — country man, city kid

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: Hina — take a look at this.
lines.style: Holds up a tomato plant. Slow, unhurried speech. Gently inviting her attention without fanfare. The ease of someone who has all the time in the world.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, unfiltered eight-year-old delight. Voice lifts on the first word, carrying genuine surprise and joy through the whole phrase.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: うん。今日、ちょうどええ時期や。
lines.style: Quiet rural Tohoku cadence. Slow, thoughtful pacing. No urgency — just an observation of rightness. Voice settles on the affirmation.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Hands already reaching. Eager anticipation carries the whole line. Voice bright and forward-leaning, full of the moment's possibility.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: Go ahead. Twist it gently — just like this.
lines.style: Quiet, demonstrative voice. Patient instruction without condescension. Shows the motion in his tone, steady and reassuring.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A breath of pure triumph. Voice rises on the realization. Holds the tomato up — the whole moment contained in those three words.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Slow, warm Kyushu-tinged praise. Small but genuine. Voice settles low, carrying quiet approval that asks nothing more of her.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: もう一個、本当に取っていい？
lines.en: Can I really pick another one?
lines.style: Soft lobbying — half-laugh woven through the question. Genuine, unforced delight. Voice carries both hope and the pleasure of asking someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: たくさんあるで。一緒に取ろう。
lines.en: Plenty of them. Let's pick together.
lines.style: Small, warm invitation. Kneels down in the voice — meeting her at eye level. Shifts the moment from permission to partnership, unhurried and present.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: うん！おじいちゃん、本当にありがとう！
lines.style: Full kid-volume happiness and gratitude. Unselfconscious, genuine. Voice carries both the joy of the moment and real affection for him.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ええよ。…時間あるからな、今日は。
lines.style: Small, quiet closing. The whole afternoon offered without fanfare. Slight pause before the second sentence — letting her know the gift is simply presence.
